OFFICIAL TREATY DOCUMENT
Treaty: The Harmony Accord of 1244
Parties: The Steam Knights of Iron Forge and The Scholars of the Floating Library
Date: Sealed on the 15th day of the Third Moon, Year 1244
Witnessed by: The Scholars of the Floating Library
Location: The Neutral Grounds

PREAMBLE:
WHEREAS The Steam Knights of Iron Forge, led by Commander Gearhart the Ironclad, recognizes the importance of Power vs responsibility;
AND WHEREAS The Scholars of the Floating Library, led by Chronicler Aria the Keeper, acknowledges the necessity of cooperation in face of the awakening;
AND WHEREAS both parties understand that Harmony Accord signed affects all of Aethermoor;

NOW THEREFORE, both parties do hereby agree as follows:

ARTICLE I - MUTUAL RECOGNITION
Both parties shall respect boundaries regarding Harmony Bells - instruments that suppress conflict.

ARTICLE II - TERRITORIAL PROVISIONS
The Elderwood shall be recognized as protected space, accessible to both parties under equal terms.

ARTICLE III - RESOURCE SHARING
The Steam Knights of Iron Forge strengths (Heavy machinery, Disciplined forces) shall be made available to The Scholars of the Floating Library in exchange for their strengths (Information networks, Historical records).

ARTICLE IV - CONFLICT RESOLUTION
In matters of Progress vs tradition, both parties agree to assist before taking unilateral action.

ARTICLE V - ANCIENT TECHNOLOGY
All discoveries related to The Codex Mechanica - ancient instruction manual shall be shared between parties within 30 days of discovery.

ARTICLE VI - DURATION AND RENEWAL
This treaty shall remain in force for 5 years (until Year 1249) and may be renewed by mutual agreement.

ARTICLE VII - BREACH PROVISIONS
Violation of this treaty shall result in arbitration by the Scholars of the Floating Library.

SIGNED AND SEALED:
Commander Gearhart the Ironclad, on behalf of The Steam Knights of Iron Forge
Chronicler Aria the Keeper, on behalf of The Scholars of the Floating Library

Witnessed by: Chronicler Aria the Keeper
Related Documents: Chronicle Entry #15, Correspondence #1014

PUBLIC ADDRESS TO THE PEOPLE OF AETHERMOOR
Speaker: Archmage Lysander, Leader of Techno-Mages
Occasion: Response to Harmony Accord signed
Location: The Neutral Grounds
Date: Year 1247, Day 418

Citizens of Aethermoor,

I stand before you in these unprecedented times, not as Leader of Techno-Mages alone, but as a fellow inhabitant of this transforming world.

Harmony Accord signed marks a turning point in our history. For too long, our factions have viewed Unity vs independence as insurmountable division. Today, I say: No more.

The ancient ones who built Ethercrystals - conduits between magic and technology did not intend for us to stand apart. They built bridges, not walls. They created systems of unity, not instruments of separation.

I call upon:
- The Techno-Mages of the Crystal Spire: Share your knowledge
- The Nature Guardians of Elderwood: Lend your wisdom
- The Steam Knights of Iron Forge: Provide your strength
- The Scholars of the Floating Library: Offer your guidance

Together, we face Ancient technology vs natural order not as enemies, but as partners. The convergence demands nothing less than complete cooperation.

Some will call this idealistic. Some will say Visionary but arrogant character makes me unsuitable to lead this charge. But I ask you: What choice do we have?

The The World Engine - mysterious device beneath Aethermoor awakens. The world changes. We change with it, or we perish.

I have seen the treaties (Document #4417). I have read the chronicles (Entry #418). I have spoken with leaders from every faction (Letters #1417 onwards). The path forward is clear.

Let history record that on this day, we chose unity over division, progress over stagnation, hope over fear.

For Aethermoor. For all of us. For the future.

Thank you.

[Recorded by the Chroniclers for posterity]

OFFICIAL TREATY DOCUMENT
Treaty: The Non-Aggression Accord of 1246
Parties: The Steam Knights of Iron Forge and The Scholars of the Floating Library
Date: Sealed on the 427th day of the Third Moon, Year 1246
Witnessed by: The Scholars of the Floating Library
Location: The Neutral Grounds

PREAMBLE:
WHEREAS The Steam Knights of Iron Forge, led by Commander Gearhart the Ironclad, recognizes the importance of Unity vs independence;
AND WHEREAS The Scholars of the Floating Library, led by Chronicler Aria the Keeper, acknowledges the necessity of cooperation in face of the awakening;
AND WHEREAS both parties understand that The Great Summit - all factions meet affects all of Aethermoor;

NOW THEREFORE, both parties do hereby agree as follows:

ARTICLE I - MUTUAL RECOGNITION
Both parties shall maintain peace regarding Ethercrystals - conduits between magic and technology.

ARTICLE II - TERRITORIAL PROVISIONS
The The Neutral Grounds shall be recognized as shared territory, accessible to both parties under equal terms.

ARTICLE III - RESOURCE SHARING
The Steam Knights of Iron Forge strengths (Heavy machinery, Disciplined forces) shall be made available to The Scholars of the Floating Library in exchange for their strengths (Information networks, Historical records).

ARTICLE IV - CONFLICT RESOLUTION
In matters of Knowledge vs action, both parties agree to assist before taking unilateral action.

ARTICLE V - ANCIENT TECHNOLOGY
All discoveries related to The Codex Mechanica - ancient instruction manual shall be shared between parties within 30 days of discovery.

ARTICLE VI - DURATION AND RENEWAL
This treaty shall remain in force for 5 years (until Year 1251) and may be renewed by mutual agreement.

ARTICLE VII - BREACH PROVISIONS
Violation of this treaty shall result in arbitration by the Scholars of the Floating Library.

SIGNED AND SEALED:
Commander Gearhart the Ironclad, on behalf of The Steam Knights of Iron Forge
Chronicler Aria the Keeper, on behalf of The Scholars of the Floating Library

Witnessed by: Chronicler Aria the Keeper

Treaty: The Cooperation Accord of 1249
Parties: The Scholars of the Floating Library and The Techno-Mages of the Crystal Spire
Date: Sealed on the 500th day of the Fourth Moon, Year 1249
Witnessed by: The Scholars of the Floating Library
Location: The Neutral Grounds

PREAMBLE:
WHEREAS The Scholars of the Floating Library, led by Chronicler Aria the Keeper, recognizes the importance of Ancient technology vs natural order;
AND WHEREAS The Techno-Mages of the Crystal Spire, led by Archmage Lysander the Illuminated, acknowledges the necessity of cooperation in face of the awakening;
AND WHEREAS both parties understand that New Council of Unity formed affects all of Aethermoor;

NOW THEREFORE, both parties do hereby agree as follows:

ARTICLE I - MUTUAL RECOGNITION
Both parties shall respect boundaries regarding The Convergence Core - ancient device powering the awakening.

ARTICLE II - TERRITORIAL PROVISIONS
The Iron Forge shall be recognized as diplomatic zone, accessible to both parties under equal terms.

ARTICLE III - RESOURCE SHARING
The Scholars of the Floating Library strengths (Information networks, Historical records) shall be made available to The Techno-Mages of the Crystal Spire in exchange for their strengths (Ethereal engineering, Crystal magic).

ARTICLE IV - CONFLICT RESOLUTION
In matters of Knowledge vs action, both parties agree to consult before taking unilateral action.

ARTICLE V - ANCIENT TECHNOLOGY
All discoveries related to Ethercrystals - conduits between magic and technology shall be shared between parties within 30 days of discovery.

ARTICLE VI - DURATION AND RENEWAL
This treaty shall remain in force for 5 years (until Year 1254) and may be renewed by mutual agreement.

ARTICLE VII - BREACH PROVISIONS
Violation of this treaty shall result in arbitration by the Scholars of the Floating Library.

Chronicler Aria the Keeper, on behalf of The Scholars of the Floating Library
Archmage Lysander the Illuminated, on behalf of The Techno-Mages of the Crystal Spire
